title: Independent Web Development Projects
description: I worked on various web development projects for clients, including a courier booking platform, business websites, and other freelance projects. I worked across both frontend and backend development using PHP, MySQL, JavaScript, React, and Tailwind CSS.

title: Programming Tutor
description: I taught students about coding in programming languages like JavaScript, Python, SQL, and relational database systems through in-person lessons and Fiverr. I helped my students understand programming fundamentals, solve problems, debug their code, and build small projects.

I joined Bounce Insights, a market intelligence company, as a Software Engineer Intern. I worked with the engineering team on their backend, mainly improving automated test coverage and writing tests for their REST API.

I launched a startup called LocaleHost, where I am building a property rental platform for the Irish market. As the sole software engineer, I handle everything from designing the product and building the application to managing the infrastructure and deployment. Developing the platform using TypeScript, React, Node.js, Fastify, Python, PostgreSQL, Docker, and Cloudflare.

I started MTUMods, an open source initiative for students at Munster Technological University to build software outside of their courses. The goal is to give students a place to work on real projects, collaborate with each other, and contribute to something that can benefit the wider MTU community.
